title: The reconcile helper's operator alerts (unaffordable, mined-but-reverted, landed-not-ours, ceiling-hit) are wired to a no-op by all three strategies, so none of those messages reaches Telegram; the operator only sees each caller's generic text

evidence.note: unaffordable: the message tells the operator to top up the wallet, then await alert(msg)
reverted / landed-not-ours / ceiling-hit each await alert(msg); also :627, :653, :659, :667
passes undefined for alert, with the comment "(no-op until ctx-bound)"

sibling_sites_checked: All submitWithReconciliation callers (the three strategies; no other caller at the base SHA). What the operator sees instead: a snipe that throws reaches the buy catch, which reports "zero ETH spent" whatever the reason (AUD-BUY-002); a private sell that throws becomes landed:false and the exit path sends its own fallback alert (exitEngine.ts:533-537), and the no-double-sell guard alerts on landed-not-ours itself (:955-972). So a mined-but-reverted buy (gas spent) or a landed-not-ours buy (nonce taken by an earlier attempt that may have bought) is never named to the operator.
severity_rationale: S3: misleading operator telemetry; the log lines (op: mev.*) are still written, and the capital consequences of the hidden outcomes are owned by AUD-BUY-002 (buy) and the exit guard (sell).
recommendation: Phase 29 (or with the Phase 24 AUD-BUY-002 fix): bind the helper alert to sendCtxAlert(ctx, ...) through sendTxWithRetry, so landed-not-ours and reverted outcomes are named to the operator.
